method: Prospective supplemental audit selected from the known webhook counterexample, before any async-cache model outcome: old load pending, clear, new load pending, old rejects, third same-id request. Apply uniformly to all six async-cache solutions; no prompt, scorer, runtime, tasks, order or budgets changed. Keep registered build/scorer endpoints separate from expanded audit.
criterion: A stale failure must not release a current-generation reservation and permit duplicate loads.
